name: Utopia OS Guards
description: Re-implements the Utopia OS guardrail + hygiene hooks (stand-down, skill-lint, verify-after-write, auto-compound reset, fleet-bus poll, reply/finalize guard) as OpenClaw typed plugin hooks. Each handler shells out to the unchanged portable Python gate under scripts/, so only the wiring is rewritten, not the logic.

utopiaRoot.description: Absolute path to the utopia-os checkout. Used to locate scripts/. Falls back to the UTOPIA_OS_ROOT env var.
